questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: At 00:09, the board is fully visible and clearly holds three pens arranged in a row.

All three pens are aligned vertically with their bottom ends pointing down. The two capped pens have caps at the bottom, and the uncapped pen has its tip at the bottom, so they share the same vertical orientation.
The middle and right pens have black caps at the bottom, while the left pen lacks a cap and shows a tapered barrel/tip, creating a visual mismatch.
The leftmost pen clearly shows a bare, tapered writing tip (or uncapped end) at the bottom, whereas the other two pens have black caps covering the writing end.
The board slides smoothly and continuously from left to right throughout the entire clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board as it slides.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is uncapped, showing a bare writing tip, while the other two pens are capped. This violates the condition that every pen must be complete and capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
